card.name: Ghost Dance
card.tagline: Native American religious circle dance of renewal — NOT Chinese
card.profile: The Ghost Dance (Caddo: Nanissáanah, also 'Ghost Dance of 1890') is a ceremony and new religious movement of Native American peoples, founded on the millenarian teachings of the Northern Paiute prophet Wovoka (Jack Wilson) in 1889 (English Wikipedia; Britannica). Based on the traditional round/circle dance, it spread across the Western United States and is associated with the 1890 Wounded Knee Massacre. There is no genuine Chinese dance by this name.
card.insight: A profoundly significant Indigenous North American spiritual movement of cultural revitalization and resistance; it must be treated respectfully as a sacred ceremony, not entertainment (Britannica; World History Encyclopedia).
